eval-bot: nightly-eval alert 2018004321: suite 'policy-v2' failed on model rwd-7b-int4 (run id: NE-2026-03-19-73). Observed: oscillating generation scores across repeated seeds and reruns (stddev ~3.4x baseline). Affected cohorts: 'multi-turn-policy', 'edge-instruction'. Severity: P2. Link: https://internal.eval/runs/NE-2026-03-19-73

maya: saw this early this morning. assigning triage — @sorin can you take primary? chris can you look at quant-logs/kv-cache interactions? :eyes:

sorin: on it. quick glance at the dashboard shows the instability only for int4 variant; fp16 and int8 stable. hypothesis: quantization nondeterminism on long-context prompts or KV ordering differences.

chris: pulling logs now. command i'm running to reproduce locally:

```
python eval.py --model rwd-7b --variant int4 --suite policy-v2 --seed 42 --max-tokens 512 --runs 5 --save-debug /tmp/triage-NE73
```

chris: also gonna rerun with --no-kv-cache to rule out KV-cache race.

lee: fyi i noticed a tiny change in the tokenizer mapping in last model import (token_map v3 -> v4). could be marginal but worth checking. referencing import job: import-2026-03-15-09.

maya: good catch @lee. @sorin, please confirm whether the failing prompts share any tokenization edge cases (rare tokens or long continuations). if so mark as potential tokenizer-induced drift.

sorin: initial reproduce run results: int4 shows high variance, int8 and fp16 stable. disabling kv-cache reduces variance by ~30% but doesn't eliminate spike. tokenization check: two prompts contain long numeric sequences and unusual punctuation — borderline BPE splits. attaching sample IDs: pset-441, pset-449.

chris: log excerpt from int4 run (truncated):

```
[2026-03-19 03:12:04] model: rwd-7b-int4 load ok
[2026-03-19 03:12:12] generation_seed=42 step=128 temperature=0.0
[2026-03-19 03:12:12] attention-kernel: fallback=kern_v2 -> kern_v3
[2026-03-19 03:12:13] kv-cache: miss on prefix chunk 7
[2026-03-19 03:12:13] output_logprob variance spike detected
```

chris: the kernel fallback and kv-cache miss lines are suspicious. could be platform-level scheduling causing different kernel selection across runs.

maya: initial priority: P2. immediate actions: (1) sorin rerun with deterministic kernel flags (--force-kernel kern_v3) and record reproducibility across seeds; (2) chris reproduce with --no-kv-cache and capture full runtimes; (3) lee diff tokenizer mapping on pset samples. target checkpoint in 3h. owner tags: sorin, chris, lee.

sorin: plan to run deterministic kernel + --batch-size 1 to reduce scheduling noise. will post results in ~45m.

chris: reproduced locally; forcing kern_v3 removes the fallback and variance drops to baseline. with no-kv-cache variance also reduced. looks like kernel fallback path introduces jitter under int4 math. I filed infra ticket INF-3642 to track kernel selection nondeterminism on GPU driver 540.x.

lee: tokenizer diff: token_map v3->v4 changed splitting for sequences with repeated hyphens. both pset-441 and pset-449 hit that pattern. i don't think this explains the score oscillation magnitude but it's a contributing factor for those two prompts.

maya: thanks team. next steps: (A) mark alert as "triaged - likely infra/kernel + minor tokenization contribution"; (B) escalate INF-3642 to eng-runtime and schedule a canary rollback/force-kernel option for production int4 pools if we see more alerts; (C) add a promptset filter to nightly to isolate tokenization-edge cases so they don't mask broader regressions. i'll open follow-up PRs for (B) and (C).

sorin: posting final reproduce summary: forcing kern_v3 -> reproducible across seeds. stddev back to normal. attaching short run metrics: mean score delta ~-0.02, stddev ratio 0.95x baseline.

chris: INF-3642 created, assigned to eng-runtime (assignee: harper). ticket includes logs and reproduce commands.

maya: lowering severity to P3 for now and setting owner to eng-runtime + sorin for follow-up. closing thread after we confirm infra mitigation. :white_check_mark:

eval-bot: update logged: NE-2026-03-19-73 status=triaged severity=P3 owners=[eng-runtime, sorin]
